summary: No restricted grammar after adjudication: both `review` flags are plain adjectives and the length finding is a segmentation artefact. Vocabulary is the glossed mock-courtly set plus three lexicon gaps (supercool, witblond, flirten); the only real issues are the `gooide … terug` dialogue tag (unidiomatic and mis-parsable, also the lemma that pushes the stretch budget over) and a needless gloss on `eer`. Natural, light Dutch; the splits in b057, b059, b061 and b062 are the right moves for this profile.

findings.required_fix: `antwoordde de andere jongen, met een glimlach`. This also brings the unglossed stretch lemmas back to 3.

findings.required_fix: Optional: `De anderen begonnen meestal op dit moment met huilen.`
